description: Fetch the full document for an id returned by search: a rental company (contact, terms, fleet with daily rates), a model family (price summary over every listed car, plus up to 50 of the cars with prices and companies), a city (makes available there and up to 30 cars; metadata.truncated says when more are listed) or a news article. Use this when you have an id from search and need the details of that one result; cite its url. Pass the id unchanged; an unknown id returns an error.

id.description: an id from search results: company:<slug>, family:<make>/<family>, city:<city>-<st> or news:<slug>

name: fetch

as_of.description: date (YYYY-MM-DD) of the catalog's last content change
